# Arena Sport

> > Arena is a premium competitive swimwear and activewear brand rooted in swimming since 1973, offering FINA-approved racing suits, sustainable collections, and performance apparel for swimmers and athletes worldwide.

Arena Sport specializes in high-performance competitive swimwear with World Aquatics approval, featuring innovative technologies like Powerskin racing suits and sustainable materials made from recycled PET plastic. The brand combines athletic excellence with environmental responsibility across its product lines.

## Key Topics

- Arena brand
- FINA-approved racing suits
- Powerskin technology
- World Aquatics
- Competitive swimming
- Sustainable materials
- Recycled PET plastic
- Women's swimwear
- One-piece swimsuits
- Two-piece swimsuits
- Shaping swimwear
- Triathlon wetsuits
- Activewear
- Feel Collections
- Quick-drying fabrics

## Women's Competitive Swimwear

- [Women's Racing Suits](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear/racing-suits.html): FINA-approved Powerskin racing suits for competitive swimmers worn by world champions
- [Women's Swimwear](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear.html): Women's professional racing and training swimwear with sustainable materials
- [Women's One-Piece Swimsuits](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear/one-piece-suits.html): One-piece swimsuits made from recycled PET plastic bottles
- [Women's Two-Piece Swimsuits](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear/two-piece-suits.html): Two-piece bikini and bralette swimsuits with recycled sustainable materials
- [Women's Shaping Swimwear](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear/shaping-suits.html): Form-flattering shaping swimwear with recycled fibers and 60-day returns

## Women's Specialty & Activewear

- [Women's Triathlon & Open-Water Suits](https://www.arenasport.com/en_us/women/swimwear/triathlon-open-water.html): Triathlon wetsuits and open-water suits with thermal insulation
